camp.story.0: Writes to a daughter every day. Hasn't mailed a single letter yet.
camp.story.1: Baked bread before the war. Still has flour in every pocket.
camp.story.2: Enlisted to find an older brother.
camp.story.3: Lost family to the cats. Doesn't say much.
camp.story.4: Good singer. Hums in the trenches every night.
camp.story.5: Used the first paycheck to send Mother a wheel of cheese.
camp.story.6: Keeps a fiancée's photo taped inside the helmet.
camp.story.7: Claimed to be sixteen at enlistment. Actually fourteen.
camp.story.8: Talks about going to see the sea when the war is over.
camp.story.9: Was a watchmaker. Hands still don't shake.
camp.story.10: Here to pay off gambling debts. Still believes luck is on their side.
camp.story.11: Former choir member. Never goes into battle without a prayer.
